plugins.name: openviking-memory
plugins.description: OpenViking long-term semantic memory for ZCode: auto-recall at session start and on every prompt, turn capture on Stop, and find/search/read/remember MCP tools via a stdio proxy.

description_i18n.zh-CN: OpenViking 长期语义记忆:会话启动与每次提问时自动召回,Stop 时增量捕获对话,并经 stdio 代理提供 find/search/read/remember 等 MCP 工具。
